text:
Ana Morales: Heads-up — launch week asset ask for the benchmark webinar and social push. Need a lightweight bundle: 1) hero comparison tile for blog + LinkedIn (metrics-forward), 2) a 3-card social carousel (1:1) with a CTA card, 3) keynote slide master with a routed CTA button and a fixed-width code snippet area, 4) a tiny 1:1 micro-infographic that explains cache+batching. Must be brand-compliant and accessible. First drafts by Thu EOD.
Lina Chen: Copy. Quick check: which latency metric do we feature? p95 only, or p50+p95? Also confirm throughput metric: tokens/sec or req/s?
Priya Kapoor: For messaging mix, use p95 + tokens/sec. Keep the hero headline factual — legal prefers no superlatives. Draft headline idea: "Efficient inference: lower unit cost, predictable latency." We'll keep a marketing-friendly variant for socials.
Kate Rivera: Brand rules: primary accent = Approved Blue #0A6CF0, secondary accent = Neutral Teal #12B8A4. Logo clearspace as per Brand Kit v2. Provide SVGs for logos & icons and 2x flattened PNGs for exports. Text contrast must meet AA; aim for AAA on tiny UI elements. No decorative gradients that reduce legibility.
Design-Bot: Starter Figma file created: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/bench-launch-stub. Export guidance embedded: hero 1200x628 PNG @2x, carousel 1080x1080 @2x, slide master 1920x1080 (left gutter 96px). Include an "alt_text.csv" with one-line alt descriptions.
Lina Chen: Design questions: 1) hero visualization — stacked bars (cost stacked by token type) or side-by-side bars (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)? 2) micro-infographic — icon-driven or data-driven?
Ana Morales: Side-by-side bars for hero (clear comparison). Micro-infographic should be icon-driven with a tiny annotation line showing "cache + batching -> 30-50% lower cost" (use as illustrative only).
Priya Kapoor: Legal note — we need a conservative alternate headline layer for APAC and EU ad channels. Also include a small metadata strip reading: "Model: open-llm-7B — seq len 512 — see notes". The test harness link should be referenced as "Notes" per legal guidance and hidden behind a disclosure on the web page.
Jordan Lee: Routing: slide CTA must point to the webinar form and tag leads with bench_launch_q2_2026. Also add utm_campaign=bench_q2 and utm_source=linkedin when used for social. I'll update the routing doc once assets are uploaded. Provide a CSV mapping of CTAs -> tags so Growth can wire the form.
Kate Rivera: Accessibility reminder: check color of the cost delta badge (green) for contrast; provide a patterned mono fallback for printers. Also request icon stroke weights meet the iconography spec.
Design-Bot: Export presets added to Figma file: 
```
- hero: 1200x628 PNG @2x, sRGB, max 2MB
- carousel: 1080x1080 PNG @2x, sRGB
- slide: 1920x1080 PNG, and PDF slide master export option
- SVGs: logos + high-contrast icon set
- include dark-mode variants for slide master and hero overlay
```
Lina Chen: Timeline — I'll post first frames by Tue AM, iterate Wed, final exports Thu EOD. Who's owning copy QA and visual QA?
Ana Morales: Marketing owns copy QA; Design handles visual QA (contrast, bleed, export checks). Jordan will confirm routing. Priya will own the conservative wording and legal sign-off.
Priya Kapoor: I'll upload the conservative copy layer by Wed noon. Also request translations for JP/KO/FR/DE — will need final strings by Thu noon to hand to localization.
Design-Bot: Added layers in Figma: "conservative_copy", "motion_ready" (small Lottie-friendly assets), and "alt_text" frame. Stubs uploaded to /s3/bench/launch/5311112222_stubs.zip (marketing permissions).
Jordan Lee: I'll take routing ownership. Please include a simple spreadsheet with: CTA text, destination URL, lead tag, utm params. I'll wire bench_launch_q2_2026 and bench_apac_variant tags.
Lina Chen: Mock frames posted: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/frame-A — includes side-by-side bars, cost delta badge, metadata strip, code snippet box 320x160px (fixed width) and a dark-mode variant.
Ana Morales: Shared with Growth and Ops. Growth — please pre-seed the form with the bench_launch_q2_2026 tag and add lead scoring for downloads.
Kate Rivera: Quick pass done — swapped to Approved Blue 2 for better contrast on the CTA, adjusted logo lockups, added a patterned mono fallback. Left comments in Figma.
Priya Kapoor: Conservative copy layer uploaded under "conservative_copy". Legal-Bot: flagged one claim line (cost delta range) for clarification — please add A/B test disclosure on the landing page.
Design-Bot: Checklist status: [x] Figma file + layers, [ ] alt_text.csv, [ ] exported assets, [ ] routing csv. Link: https://internal.redwood/ops/bench-launch-prd
Ana Morales: Thanks — please drop final export links here when ready and tag Jordan + Priya. Also create a one-slide LinkedIn keynote variant (single image with short caption) for the launch post.
Jordan Lee: Noted — ping me when exports live. I'll update the routing doc and confirm growth pre-seed.
Lina Chen: Final exports scheduled for Thu EOD. Posting final zip when done. If anything blocks, will raise here. :art: :sparkles:
